definition: Unique trial identifier matching the run manifest
acceptance: non-empty and consistent with metric summary

definition: ROS time associated with the telemetry sample
acceptance: monotonic within a trial

definition: Wall-clock time on the robot computer
acceptance: monotonic within a trial

definition: ROS topic or subsystem represented by the row
acceptance: one of required telemetry topics or system monitor

definition: Header or payload timestamp for the observed message
acceptance: finite when the topic carries timestamps

definition: Collector receipt timestamp
acceptance: finite and not earlier than message_stamp_s after clock correction

definition: receive_stamp_s minus message_stamp_s after clock correction
acceptance: reported as mean p95 and p99 in metric summary

definition: Elapsed time since the previous message on the same topic
acceptance: used to detect frame drops and stalled topics

definition: Per-topic sequential sample index
acceptance: strictly increasing by topic

definition: Cumulative missing or late-frame count
acceptance: zero or explicitly explained in incident report

definition: ROS-time versus wall-time drift estimate
acceptance: p95 archived before timing claims

definition: Age of latest follower-leader TF sample
acceptance: p95 below trial-specific threshold or incident filed

definition: Age of latest selected-leader diagnostic payload
acceptance: p95 below trial-specific threshold or incident filed

definition: Age of latest safe shadow command
acceptance: p95 below watchdog timeout before actuator bridge

definition: Whether the watchdog fired for this sample
acceptance: every trigger appears in safety_state and incident report

definition: Reason emitted by the watchdog or safety supervisor
acceptance: non-empty when watchdog_trigger is true

definition: Serialized safety state for the follower robot
acceptance: contains safety_stop and reason fields

definition: Robot-computer CPU load
acceptance: mean and p95 archived by trial

definition: Robot-computer GPU load
acceptance: mean and p95 archived by trial

definition: Robot-computer GPU memory in use
acceptance: peak archived by trial

definition: Robot-computer host memory in use
acceptance: peak archived by trial

definition: Thermal or throttling state if available
acceptance: reported when available on embedded target

definition: Relative or absolute path to the associated rosbag2 directory
acceptance: exists in archived evidence package

definition: Collector name or command that produced the row
acceptance: one of ros2 bag
